newsitem.title: USA: Micron says has not reached deal with Compaq.
newsitem.headline: Micron says has not reached deal with Compaq.

text.p: Micron Technology Inc and its 64 percent-owned unit Micron Electronics Inc on Friday denied they are in active talks with Compaq Computer Corp about its possible acquisition of Micron Electronics.

In a joint statement, the two Idaho-based companies acknowledged one of their directors made comments about early talks with Compaq, but added they "are not currently engaged in active discussions" and "no offer has been received."
Earlier this week PC Week Online published a story saying the companies were in preliminary discussions, sparking rumors of a deal and sending Micron Electronics' stock price higher.
Micron Electronics makes personal computer systems for consumers, businesses and on a contract basis for original equipment manufacturers.
Its parent, Micron Technology, is a maker of semiconductor chips for personal computers and other electronic equipment.
A spokeswoman for Compaq, which makes personal computers for home and business use, declined to comment on the matter.
